steps.claim: Three of the four claims: uγx has level j (the set of terms of level j is stable under 𝖴 on both sides); Z(uγx) = frameMatrix(u⁻¹)ᴴ Z(γ) frameMatrix(x) = Z(γ) since elements of 𝖴⁰ fix the frame; uγx lies over (c, s, c') because u lies over (c, 1, c) and x over (c', 1, c').
